catalog.name: Drought & Water Stress Indicators
catalog.description: Advanced drought monitoring and water stress indicators combining multiple NASA satellite observations to provide comprehensive drought assessment capabilities. These products integrate soil moisture, precipitation, vegetation, and water storage data for early warning and impact assessment.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: Drought indicators derived from multiple NASA missions including GRACE, SMAP, MODIS, GLDAS, and MERRA-2. Processing by NASA Goddard Space Flight Center drought monitoring team. Contact: earthdata-support@nasa.gov

info.name: License
info.content: NASA data is generally available for public use. These products are designed for drought early warning and water resource management applications.

info.name: Multi-indicator Approach
info.content: Combines meteorological drought (precipitation deficit), agricultural drought (soil moisture deficit), hydrological drought (groundwater/surface water deficit), and ecological drought (vegetation stress) for comprehensive assessment.

info.name: Early Warning Value
info.content: Provides 2-4 weeks earlier drought detection compared to traditional precipitation-only indices, enabling proactive drought management and response.

members.name: Integrated Drought Indicators
members.description: Multi-variable drought indices combining soil moisture, precipitation, temperature, and water storage anomalies for comprehensive drought assessment.

members.name: GRACE-Based Drought Indicator
members.description: Monthly drought indicator based on GRACE water storage anomalies, providing deep water deficit assessment including groundwater depletion.

info.name: Background
info.content: The GRACE-based drought indicator uses total water storage anomalies to assess deep water deficits, including groundwater depletion that other drought indices cannot detect. It provides unique insights into hydrological drought conditions.

info.name: Drought Categories
info.content: Classified into categories from Normal to Exceptional Drought based on percentile ranks of water storage anomalies relative to historical record

info.name: Deep Water Assessment
info.content: Uniquely captures groundwater drought, aquifer depletion, and deep soil moisture deficits not reflected in surface-based drought indicators

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: ~300 km effective resolution, suitable for regional to continental drought assessment

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: 2002 to present, providing 20+ years of hydrological drought climatology

info.name: Unique Capabilities
info.content: Detects groundwater drought, deep soil water deficits, total water storage depletion, and long-term hydrological drought trends

info.name: Applications
info.content: Groundwater drought assessment, long-term water resource planning, aquifer depletion monitoring, hydrological drought early warning, water security evaluation

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO missions, NASA Goddard drought monitoring team

members.name: SMAP-Based Agricultural Drought Index
members.description: Daily agricultural drought index based on SMAP soil moisture observations, optimized for crop water stress detection and agricultural drought monitoring.

info.name: Background
info.content: The SMAP Agricultural Drought Index uses high-quality L-band soil moisture measurements to assess root zone water availability for crops and vegetation, providing early warning of agricultural drought conditions.

info.name: Root Zone Focus
info.content: Specifically designed to assess water availability in the root zone (top 5cm), most relevant for crop water stress and agricultural impacts

info.name: High Temporal Resolution
info.content: Daily updates provide rapid detection of developing agricultural drought conditions, enabling timely irrigation and management decisions

info.name: Agricultural Relevance
info.content: Directly measures soil water availability to crops, correlating strongly with crop yield impacts and agricultural drought stress

info.name: Early Warning Capability
info.content: Provides 2-4 weeks earlier agricultural drought detection compared to precipitation-based indices

info.name: Applications
info.content: Crop yield forecasting, irrigation management, agricultural drought early warning, crop insurance applications, precision agriculture support

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA SMAP mission team, agricultural applications development team

members.name: Vegetation Stress Indicators
members.description: Vegetation-based drought indicators using satellite observations of vegetation health, water content, and photosynthetic activity to assess ecological drought impacts.

members.name: MODIS Vegetation Health Index
members.description: Weekly vegetation health index combining vegetation condition and temperature condition indices to assess vegetation drought stress and ecosystem health.

info.name: Background
info.content: The Vegetation Health Index (VHI) combines Vegetation Condition Index (VCI) and Temperature Condition Index (TCI) to provide comprehensive assessment of vegetation health and drought stress.

info.name: Composite Approach
info.content: Integrates vegetation greenness (VCI) and land surface temperature anomalies (TCI) to assess both moisture stress and heat stress on vegetation

info.name: Ecosystem Health
info.content: Provides direct assessment of ecosystem health and vegetation drought impacts, complementing meteorological and agricultural drought indicators

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 1 km spatial resolution enabling detailed vegetation drought monitoring

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: 2000 to present, providing 20+ years of vegetation drought climatology

info.name: Applications
info.content: Ecosystem drought monitoring, rangeland management, forest health assessment, fire risk evaluation, biodiversity conservation planning

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, vegetation health monitoring team

members.name: Enhanced Vegetation Index Anomaly
members.description: Monthly Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) anomalies showing vegetation condition relative to long-term average, indicating drought impacts on vegetation productivity.

info.name: Background
info.content: EVI anomalies show vegetation condition relative to the long-term average, indicating areas where drought is impacting vegetation productivity and photosynthetic activity.

info.name: Productivity Indicator
info.content: Directly measures vegetation productivity changes due to water stress, providing early indication of drought impacts on ecosystems

info.name: Anomaly Interpretation
info.content: Negative anomalies indicate below-normal vegetation condition (drought stress), positive anomalies indicate above-normal vegetation health

info.name: Applications
info.content: Drought impact assessment, ecosystem monitoring, agricultural productivity analysis, carbon cycle studies, food security applications

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS mission team, vegetation index processing team

members.name: Meteorological Drought Indicators
members.description: Satellite-derived meteorological drought indicators based on precipitation and temperature anomalies, providing standardized drought assessment capabilities.

members.name: Standardized Precipitation Index (Satellite)
members.description: Monthly Standardized Precipitation Index calculated from satellite precipitation estimates, providing standardized meteorological drought assessment for data-sparse regions.

info.name: Background
info.content: Satellite-derived SPI uses precipitation estimates from TRMM, GPM, and other satellite missions to calculate standardized precipitation indices for regions lacking ground-based data.

info.name: Global Coverage
info.content: Provides SPI calculations for regions without adequate rain gauge networks, particularly over oceans, remote areas, and developing countries

info.name: Standardized Scale
info.content: Uses standard SPI classification: >2.0 (Extremely Wet), 1.5-2.0 (Very Wet), 1.0-1.5 (Moderately Wet), -1.0 to 1.0 (Near Normal), -1.5 to -1.0 (Moderately Dry), -2.0 to -1.5 (Severely Dry), <-2.0 (Extremely Dry)

info.name: Multiple Timescales
info.content: Available at 1, 3, 6, 12, and 24-month timescales to assess short-term to long-term meteorological drought conditions

info.name: Applications
info.content: Global drought monitoring, international drought assessment, climate services, drought early warning in data-sparse regions

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA precipitation missions, World Meteorological Organization drought monitoring standards

members.name: Precipitation Percentile Anomalies
members.description: Monthly precipitation percentile anomalies from satellite observations, showing current precipitation relative to historical record for drought assessment.

info.name: Background
info.content: Precipitation percentile anomalies show current precipitation conditions relative to the historical record, providing intuitive assessment of meteorological drought severity.

info.name: Percentile Interpretation
info.content: Values <10th percentile indicate severe drought, <5th percentile extreme drought, >90th percentile wet conditions, >95th percentile extremely wet conditions

info.name: Historical Context
info.content: Provides historical context by showing where current conditions rank relative to the full satellite record

info.name: Applications
info.content: Meteorological drought assessment, water resource planning, seasonal climate monitoring, drought risk communication

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA satellite precipitation missions, drought monitoring algorithm development team

members.name: Composite Drought Indices
members.description: Advanced composite drought indices combining multiple variables and data sources for comprehensive operational drought monitoring and decision support.

members.name: Multi-satellite Drought Index
members.description: Weekly composite drought index combining soil moisture, precipitation, vegetation, and water storage data for comprehensive drought assessment and early warning.

info.name: Background
info.content: The Multi-satellite Drought Index combines data from GRACE, SMAP, MODIS, TRMM/GPM, and other missions to provide comprehensive drought assessment that captures all aspects of drought development and impacts.

info.name: Multi-variable Integration
info.content: Integrates meteorological (precipitation), agricultural (soil moisture), hydrological (water storage), and ecological (vegetation) drought indicators

info.name: Comprehensive Assessment
info.content: Provides most complete picture of drought conditions by combining surface and subsurface water, vegetation health, and atmospheric conditions

info.name: Early Warning Capability
info.content: Provides earliest possible drought detection by combining multiple drought indicators, typically 4-6 weeks earlier than single-variable approaches

info.name: Operational Applications
info.content: Designed for operational drought early warning, water resource management, agricultural decision support, and emergency response coordination

info.name: Applications
info.content: Operational drought monitoring, early warning systems, water resource management, agricultural planning, disaster preparedness, food security assessment

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA multi-mission drought monitoring team, operational drought applications development
